outcome.answer: For finding evidence subgraphs in a hidden-structure knowledge graph without training, BubbleRAG is the closest match: it is training-free and designed for black-box graphs whose schema and structure are unknown, using candidate evidence-graph discovery and ranking [5]. QAFD-RAG is also training-free and query-adaptively traverses a graph to recover relevant subgraphs, but its abstract does not specifically describe hidden graph structure [3].
